offering_description.value: Supplies refrigerants for HVAC and refrigeration systems and reclaims used refrigerant for reuse. Sells to wholesalers, contractors, equipment manufacturers and end users. Also provides refrigerant management and recovery services.

primary_products.value: refrigerant gases; reclaimed refrigerants; industrial gases for cooling systems

primary_services.value: refrigerant reclamation; refrigerant recovery and management; system decontamination and recycling; RefrigerantSide services

customer_segment.value: B2B: HVAC wholesalers, contractors, equipment manufacturers, commercial and industrial facility operators, refrigerant distributors; B2G: government and military facilities

end_markets.value: commercial HVAC; commercial refrigeration; industrial cooling; government and defense facilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: virgin and reclaimed refrigerants sold to wholesalers and end users; service fees: refrigerant reclamation, recovery and management services

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys virgin refrigerants and resells to HVAC wholesalers and contractors; service provider: recovers and reclaims used refrigerant, selling it back into the market

geography_served.value: US national: Sells across the United States from facilities in New York, Pennsylvania and other states

specialization.value: related lines: refrigerant sales, reclamation and recovery services, and related refrigerant management offerings

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to contractors, OEMs, end users and government; distributors / dealers: HVAC and refrigerant wholesalers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: EPA rules on refrigerants: Clean Air Act Section 608, AIM Act HFC phasedown, reclaimer certification
